reference.pathophysiology: Chronic blood loss or poor intake empties iron stores producing pica koilonychia with low ferritin; globin-gene defects microcytose with high red-cell counts and HbA2, and lead blocks haem enzymes with stippling and colic.
additionalDifferentials: Iron versus thalassaemia versus lead versus sideroblastic by ferritin Mentzer and stippling
Trait versus major by Hb and transfusions
GI versus menstrual versus dietary by scopes and diet
additionalInvestigations: Ferritin TIBC with smear Mentzer HbA2
